issues.topic: Two plane maps have different authority
issues.localFinding: The original Planes Ascendant narrative has four principal realms. Current Appendix B teaches a Wheel of Testimony containing 32 individually listed plane labels. Q5 makes the Great Wheel mortal cosmography.
issues.proposedReviewAction: Preserve both accounts and their authority. Do not force a one-to-one equivalence or conclude that a mortal map proves its worlds fictitious.

issues.localFinding: The original twilight/memory dominion and the player shadow-reflection account share a name; the current Shadow Conclave adds claims of death jurisdiction.
issues.proposedReviewAction: Compare the accounts without silently deciding whether every geographical, ruler and soul-route claim is objectively identical.

issues.localFinding: Bastion of Flame has a source origin and Choir stewardship; Appendix B has Plane of Fire and the Eternal Flame court. The World/Dungeon guide separately labels Brogi a Plane of Fire echo.
issues.proposedReviewAction: Distinguish plane, court, site and dungeon echo; determine which links are explicit and which remain unproved.

issues.localFinding: Radiant Currents, Boundless Void, Astral Plane and Verdant Reflection overlap thematically while having different descriptions and authority.
issues.proposedReviewAction: Do not merge dream/thought/Fey places by theme. Separate planar identity from a particular travel or perception effect.

issues.localFinding: Confluence Straits mediate inter-plane exchanges; P71 names four tributary realms. Public teaching separately lists natural portals, touchpoints and magical routes.
issues.proposedReviewAction: Preserve source connections while leaving operational endpoint, access, cost, consent, return and hazard rules to explicit procedures.

issues.localFinding: The public text names four Elemental Courts, four Fey Courts, four Shadow Conclave members and four Astral Dominions. The gods review leaves objective jurisdiction open.
issues.proposedReviewAction: Inventory each named institution and its taught domain. Do not promote a folk rank into cosmic seniority or fill the Maladomini ruler gap.

issues.topic: Planar time and the Opening clock
issues.localFinding: Dream and Astral source descriptions bend time; the source epilogue adds home-plane rest rewards. Owner Q4 sets the Opening and Horn clocks.
issues.proposedReviewAction: Require explicit travel/time/return rules; do not let descriptive time language silently stop the campaign clock or grant rests, durations or resource recovery.

issues.topic: Actual spell status and transit permission
issues.localFinding: Plane Shift, Planar Gate and other central transit effects are still pending authored procedures. Blink is receipt-only pending cosmology. Reviewed local portals and other name matches have their own limited procedures.
issues.proposedReviewAction: Reconcile topology with actual operational spell sources and pending proposals. A named plane, portal service price or source spell summary is not a complete travel permission.

issues.localFinding: P270-P276 offers a Spiral Map and home-plane choices at session zero after the source saga. The current campaign revelation ladder restricts common knowledge of the hidden machinery.
issues.proposedReviewAction: Keep the source map and game rules inventoried. Decide epoch and disclosure before using it as a current player handout; no automatic home-plane benefits.

issues.localFinding: Boundless Void is a questioning dominion, whereas the public Void Sovereign is an entity claim. Astral soul transit and Shadow soul collection are further distinct claims.
issues.proposedReviewAction: Preserve distinctions among place, title, being and state. Carry soul/death jurisdiction and Interstice/Old-God identity to their ordered reviews.

issues.topic: Saved cosmology website and its diagram claims
issues.localFinding: The owner specifically reminded Codex to include the saved website. webpage.html is Interactive Cosmology: Calan'thir plus four labeled shells. The companion viewer has seven displayed bodies and twelve FirstSong chapter bodies matching contiguous original DOCX text after whitespace normalization. Its World I-VI entry still preserves a gap.
issues.proposedReviewAction: Read the standalone HTML and actual viewer/data. Inventory diagram/tooltip claims, distinguish labels and visual coordinates from approved topology, and retain their source contribution without silently equating the four shells, seven displayed bodies, four original primary realms or 32 mortal plane labels.
